name: FaceTune / AI eye whitening
lead: FaceTune and similar photo-editing apps let users retouch selfies, including whitening the sclera, the white part of the eye, brightening the iris and removing redness or veins. Newer AI-based editors and filters do the same automatically, often as part of a one-tap enhance or beauty feature.

People use eye whitening in edits to make eyes look brighter, clearer and more rested in photos and profile pictures. Whiter sclera and a more vivid iris are commonly associated with a healthy, alert appearance, and the edit is among the quickest ways to change how a face reads on screen.

In looksmaxxing discussion the technique is mostly raised in the context of photo presentation, such as dating profiles and social media, alongside lighting, angle and lens choices that affect how a face is captured.

angle.text: Eye whitening in photo apps brightens the whites and iris and softens redness in a picture. People use it to make eyes look clearer and more rested in profile photos and social media posts.

infobox: FaceTune and other retouching or AI beauty apps
Sclera whitening, iris brightening, redness reduction

paras: Retouching apps provide a brush or automatic tool that lightens the whites of the eyes and can sharpen or saturate the iris. AI features detect the eye region automatically and apply the adjustment without manual masking. Many also offer related edits such as teeth whitening, blemish removal and skin smoothing.

Users describe applying subtle whitening and brightening to profile and dating photos so that the eyes look more awake. Discussion of the technique tends to sit with other presentation choices such as lighting, camera distance and angle, which also change how the eye area appears.

Commentators on social media have also noted that heavily edited photos can look different from a person in real life, and some users prefer light adjustments so that images stay close to their appearance.

The edit changes only the image. People who want a brighter appearance of the eyes in person commonly discuss separate approaches such as sleep, hydration, lubricating or redness-relieving eye drops, and eyewear, which are covered in their own entries.

card.summary: Photo-editing tools that brighten the whites and iris of the eyes in pictures so the face looks fresher and more awake.
card.aka: Eye brightening, sclera whitening, Facetune eye edit
card.note: Changes appearance in photos only, not in person.

quick.overview:
Apps like FaceTune and AI beauty filters can whiten the sclera, brighten the iris and reduce redness in a photo. It is a quick way to make eyes look clearer and more rested on screen.

People use it for profile pictures, dating apps and social media posts.
quick.mechanism: The app detects or lets the user paint over the eye area and raises brightness and contrast there, sometimes with automatic AI detection of the sclera and iris.
quick.risks: The edit affects only the image. Some people note that heavy edits can look different from in-person appearance, so light adjustments are common.
